bibl.title: Acerca del contorno costero de la Iberia de Artemidoro.
bibl.seg: Manuel Albaladejo Vivero, Acerca del contorno costero de la Iberia de Artemidoro.

Francisco J. González Ponce, F. Javier Gómez Espelosín & Antonio L. Chávez Reino (edd.), La letra y la carta. Descripción verbal y representación gráfica en los diseños terrestres grecolatinos. Estudios en honor de Pietro Janni = Monografías de GAHIA. 1 (Sevilla, 2016) pp. 119-130, figg.
bibl.note: Analyzes the data on distances between points on the Iberian coast collected in the recently published Artemidorus' Papyrus. They are compared with the ones known through geographical tradition after Artemidorus. The remarkable disparity between the two sets of data is evidenced.
